body.name: \mathfrak G_{H,L}(\mathcal S)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak G_{H,L}(\mathcal S)=\{G=(\mathcal W_H,E_G^{\to},E_G^{\leftrightarrow}):G\text{ is an ADMG satisfying }\text{ass:positive-bounded-directed-lags},\ \text{ass:exact-summary-projection},\text{ and }E_G^{\leftrightarrow}\subseteq\mathcal B_H(\mathcal S)\}\). Thus \(L\) bounds directed lags only; bidirected edges may have any time separation available inside \(\mathbb T_H\).
